rv.q: The work is personal and particular, but the concept of loss is something everyone can connect with and contemplate.
Dance is Not For Us is a short powerful burst of human emotion wrapped in poetic thoughts and a forest of basil plants.

cn.t: Lebanese choreographer Omar Rajeh delivers a powerful, emotionally charged solo exploring loss and displacement through poetic movement and striking visuals, though the work's personal nature proves more resonant for some than others.
